summary: Describes TCP performance problems caused by path asymmetry, as in bandwidth-asymmetric networks and packet radio. Different causes lead to the same result: poor or variable acknowledgment feedback from receiver to sender hurts performance. It surveys the problems and ways to mitigate them.

eli5.summary: If the road one way is fast and the way back is slow, replies get stuck. TCP depends on replies, so it slows down. This note explains that and offers fixes.
